notes: Discipline skill trees (design §5): each node changes how you play. 'requires' is the discipline level and optional parent node. One skill point per discipline level gained.

skills.title: Elenchus
skills.text: Challenge people's definitions. Unlocks [Challenge] choices in conversations.

skills.title: Socratic irony
skills.text: Profess ignorance: people explain more than they meant to. Extra information in many talks.

skills.title: Sharp definitions
skills.text: Debates: start with one more point of consistency.

skills.title: Walking dialectic
skills.text: Conversations held while walking a peripatos earn double Logos.

skills.title: Against the sophists
skills.text: See through verbal tricks: fallacies are highlighted in debates.

skills.title: Midwifery
skills.text: Help others reach the answer themselves. New outcomes in side quests.

skills.title: The syllogism
skills.text: Aristotle's new logic: chain premises to force a conclusion in debates.

skills.title: Compass and ruler
skills.text: Geometry puzzles show construction guides.

skills.title: Proportion
skills.text: Eudoxus' theory: compare magnitudes at a glance (hints on ratios).

skills.title: The gnomon
skills.text: Measure the height of anything from its shadow. Unlocks the surveying tool.

skills.title: Star reading
skills.text: At night, constellations and planets are labelled in the sky.

skills.title: Method of exhaustion
skills.text: Approximate curved figures with polygons: new puzzle solutions.

skills.title: Homocentric spheres
skills.text: Fine control on Eudoxus' armillary.

skills.title: Mechanical solutions
skills.text: Use instruments, as Archytas did. Plato will not approve.

skills.title: Wind
skills.text: Sprinting and swimming tire you 30% less.

skills.title: Climber
skills.text: Vault walls up to shoulder height.

skills.title: Swimmer
skills.text: Swim faster against the Cephissus current.

skills.title: Stadion runner
skills.text: Faster sprint on tracks and roads.

skills.title: Wrestler
skills.text: Wider timing window in wrestling.

skills.title: Torchbearer
skills.text: Your torch flame is steadier in the race.

skills.title: Pentathlete
skills.text: Discus and javelin power meters move more slowly.

skills.title: Memory palace
skills.text: Store clues at places in the garden and recall them by walking there.

skills.title: Favour of the Muses
skills.text: The Muses' herms reveal hidden scrolls nearby.

skills.title: The lyre
skills.text: Play the lyre: calm angry people, accompany festivals.

skills.title: Rhythm
skills.text: Timed actions (athletics, lyre) show the beat.

skills.title: Homer by heart
skills.text: Quote poets in debates: a well-placed line restores consistency.

skills.title: Chorus leader
skills.text: Lead songs at festivals for reputation with everyone present.

skills.title: Hymn to the Muses
skills.text: At the Mouseion, dawn hymns grant inspiration (double XP for an hour).
